description: This header file 'webpa_attribute.h' declares interfaces for Webpa Attribute operations, including getting and setting attributes via 'getAttributes' and 'setAttributes' functions, and references external components like 'webpa_adapter.h' and 'wdmp-c.h'. It also includes licensing information and documentation comments delineating its purpose.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attribute values for given parameter names, returning attribute name/value pairs, counts, and status for each parameter.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets attribute values for specified parameters, returning status information.
